Hi Marissa —

Quick heads up from the terminal: one of the advance crates for Redwood (MAWB 123-456 / house manifest RDW-ACME-05) was flagged by U.S. CBP for a regulated additive in the protective foam. The inspector has placed the crate on hold pending a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) and a vendor declaration confirming the foam formulation. We need both documents to clear customs.

Current status: crate is at Moscone inbound yard (bay 3), not released to the warehouse. Estimated inspect window is 4–6 hours once documentation is received. If documentation cannot be provided, crate may be moved to bonded storage and demurrage will begin per terminal tariff.

What we need from Redwood/Acme:
- SDS for the foam material used in the booth padding (PDF)
- Vendor declaration stating no prohibited substances OR confirmation of applicable exemption
- Confirm whether items can be re-packed or if foam can be removed for expedited release

Im copying the broker and the warehouse. Please advise whether Acme can supply SDS or if Redwood wants us to initiate removal.
